name: Gestalt
url: https://gestalt.pinterest.systems/ (docs site now Okta-gated for foundations pages; source at https://github.com/pinterest/gestalt)
licence: Apache-2.0 (gestalt and gestalt-design-tokens package.json + repo LICENSE)
bestFor: image/content-heavy consumer products (feeds, masonry grids, boards) where UI chrome must recede
consumer apps that need one bold brand colour used sparingly against near-black and warm off-white
multi-script international products (separate line-height token sets for CJK, Japanese, Thai, Vietnamese, tall scripts)
products shipping web + iOS + Android from one token source
avoidFor: dense B2B data tools (no compact density mode; controls start at 32px and go to 48px)
brands needing a cool/blue corporate feel (neutrals are warm, primary is Pinterest red #e60023)
teams that need public, ungated design guidance (foundations docs moved behind Okta sign-in in 2026)

families: default-latin (VR theme): 'Pin Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Oxygen-Sans, ... Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif (Pin Sans is proprietary)
default-latin (classic theme): -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, ... (pure system stack)
default-japanese: 'SF Pro JP', -apple-system, ... 'Hiragino Kaku Gothic Pro', Meiryo, ...
code: 'SF Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', 'Roboto Mono', 'Ubuntu Mono', Menlo, Consolas, Courier, monospace
typography.notes: Only six sizes exist (12/14/16/20/28/36) and three weights (400/500/700 in VR; 400/600/700 classic). Three parallel roles share sizes but differ in leading: body (reading, ~1.4), ui (labels/controls, ~1.2), heading. Line-height tokens are swapped per script via separate CSS files: font-lineheight-default/-ck/-ja/-th/-vi/-tall.css. Docs: 'limited number of weights and sizes to keep our interfaces focused on our customers' rich content'.

neutrals.note: warm/yellowish greys (VR theme); every base colour also has explicit -hover and -pressed variants, e.g. hover-grayscale-100 #d6d4cd, pressed-grayscale-100 #c2c1bc

semantic.background-selected: grayscale-500 #000 (dark: grayscale-100) - selection is black, not brand
semantic.focus: double ring: inner grayscale-0 / outer blue-400 #007db8
semantic.wash/scrim: background-wash-dark rgba(0,0,0,.8), wash-light rgba(255,255,255,.9), image-tint rgba(0,0,0,.04)

color.darkMode: First-class: separate variables-dark.css per theme (classic + vr-theme). Default bg becomes pure black #000, elevated surfaces grayscale-400 #2e2e2d; text/icon default flip to white; primary red unchanged; shadows replaced by heavier rgba(0,0,0,.3) stacks; docs say raised borders in dark pair with elevationRaised background.
color.contrastNotes: Docs: never use colour as the only cue. No numeric target found in the fetched source. Status text uses the darkest 500 step on light (e.g. text-error #8a0f0f) which reads as an AA-driven choice; measured: primary red #e60023 vs white 4.78:1 (AA pass, thin margin), text-subtle #636361 vs white 6.02:1, focus/info blue-400 #007db8 vs white 4.54:1 (AA by 0.04).

spacing.notes: sema-space-25..1600 (name = px*25), plus mirrored negative tokens -1..-64. 1/2/6px steps are VR-only additions.

radius.rule: Radius scales with control size: VR Button sm 8px, md 12px, lg 16px; classic Button 24px (fully pill at 48px). Datepicker container 16px, day cells circle. Generous rounding is part of the brand.

shadows: raised-bottom: mirrored (negative y) for sticky footers
depth.borders: Borders are an alternative to shadows ('not considered elevation' but usable when shadows/colour don't work): decorative grayscale-150, interactive grayscale-250.
depth.blur: none tokenised; washes are flat translucent fills

motion.notes: Semantic motion tokens by property: opacity default 300ms linear; colorchange 300ms linear; scale-on 150ms linear; position-on 300ms bounce; position-off 200ms lateral; swipe 400ms lateral. Guidelines: pause control for anything moving >5s, no flashing >3/s, non-essential motion disabled under reduced-motion (useReducedMotion hook).

modes: single density; three control sizes sm/md/lg

list: + providers (ColorScheme, DesignTokens, DeviceType, DefaultLabel, Experiment, GlobalEventsHandler) and z-index helpers
components.stateMatrixCompleteness: High for colour: every base hue ships default/hover/pressed values and semantic tokens are generated for each state (sema-color-hover-*, sema-color-pressed-*). Focus is a defined double ring. Disabled has its own text/icon/background/border tokens. Count = 91 named exports in gestalt@177.0.12 index (incl. providers).

tokenArchitecture: Three tiers, Style Dictionary, exported to CSS/JS/JSON/Android/iOS/Swift: base-* (raw: base-color-red-300, base-space-unit, base-motion-duration-300) -> sema-* (role: sema-color-text-subtle, sema-space-400, sema-font-size-body-md) -> comp-* (component: rounding-datepicker-container, font-size-datepicker-heading). Two themes ship side by side: 'classic' and 'vr-theme' (Visual Refresh), plus 'vr-theme-web-mapping' that maps old names onto VR values for migration. State is a token dimension (base-color-hover-*, base-color-pressed-*). Script-specific line-height files swap only leading.
distinctiveness: Warm off-white/near-black neutrals with a single saturated red, selection shown in black not brand colour, generous radii that grow with control size, a 'recommendation' purple role for AI/personalised content, and pre-computed hover/pressed colour ramps instead of opacity overlays.
weaknesses: Foundations documentation is now behind Okta sign-in; public guidance must be read from GitHub source
Two live themes (classic + VR) plus a mapping theme make token names ambiguous for adopters
Pin Sans is proprietary, so the VR look degrades to system fonts outside Pinterest
No compact density for data-heavy screens
Several key pairs pass AA by a hair (blue-400 on white 4.54:1, red-300 on white 4.78:1), leaving no headroom for tinted backgrounds
takeaways: Ship hover and pressed as their own pre-computed colour ramps per hue (base-color-hover-*, base-color-pressed-*) instead of runtime opacity overlays; states stay on-brand and testable
Separate 'ui' text roles (tight ~1.2 leading for labels/controls) from 'body' roles (~1.4) at the same sizes
Swap only line-height tokens per writing system (CJK, Thai, Vietnamese) via separate files
Use black/ink for selection state so the brand colour stays reserved for the single primary action
Scale radius with control height (8/12/16 for 24/32/44px)
Name motion tokens by property and direction (position-on, position-off, scale-on, colorchange) rather than by component
provenance: public-spec (gestalt-design-tokens@177.0.12 dist CSS + gestalt@177.0.12 src + docs/pages/foundations/*.tsx on GitHub master)
